how_to_apply: Visit the official portal at nandurbar.bhartiportal.org.
Read the detailed advertisement (advertisement number 01/2026) carefully.
Register and proceed to fill out the online application form with correct details.
Submit the application form online through the portal on or before 21 October 2026 at 05:45 PM.
Keep a printout or digital copy of the submitted application for future reference.
important_instructions: Only online applications submitted through nandurbar.bhartiportal.org will be accepted. Applications sent through any other mode will be rejected. Applications must be submitted between 06/10/2026 (10:00 AM) and 21/10/2026 (05:45 PM). Applicants are responsible for ensuring that their contact information and portal profile stay updated. The authority reserves the right to increase or decrease the total number of vacancies, alter rules, or cancel/suspend the recruitment process partly or completely. Final decisions regarding selection, disputes, and clarifications rest with the Selection Committee Chairman and Sub-Divisional Officer, Taloda Bhag Taloda.
